exposure: Normal weight, overweight, and obese pregnant women
outcome: Carbohydrate to insulin ratio (CHO/IR) at breakfast, lunch, and dinner
cohort: 86 Caucasian pregnant women with type 1 diabetes using insulin pump therapy
finding: Pre-gestational BMI and weight gain during pregnancy may influence carbohydrate to insulin ratio (CHO/IR) in pregnant women with type 1 diabetes using insulin pumps.
